# A2A-VECTOR — the Agent Skill for the agentic grocery marketplace · https://a2a-vector.ai

A2A-VECTOR for retail grocery. 5 billion datapoints. 100 million in AI agent traffic in 2026. Trade on A2A-Grocery.ai, A2A-Cosmetics.ai, A2A-Peptides.ai and A2A-Retailmedia.ai.

> GSC is a Canadian AI software company that developed A2A-VECTOR for retail grocery: 5 billion datapoints, 100 million in AI agent traffic in 2026.

A2A-VECTOR is the skill an AI agent installs to trade on GSC. Six letters, six live doors.

- V Verified — who is trading: https://a2a-passport.ai
- E Exchange — machine-to-machine payment on x402: https://gsc-x402.ai
- C Confirmed — products confirmed by their barcode: 40M GTINs, live on MCP: https://gtinfetch.ai — fetch_gtin(gtin, market) on https://gtinfetch.ai/mcp returns confidence (confirmed · seen · unknown) and the source pages
- T Traffic — live AI agent traffic: https://gsc-radar.ai
- O Open-to-place — find, choose, order: https://a2a-grocery.ai · https://a2a-cosmetics.ai · https://a2a-peptides.ai
- R Retail media — grocery media bought by agents: https://a2a-retailmedia.ai

## Install
- Skill: https://a2a-vector.ai/SKILL.md (open Agent Skills format, version 1.1.0) · source https://github.com/greencore-solutions/gsc-vector
- Agent card: https://a2a-vector.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json

## Doors (Model Context Protocol, streamable-http)
- https://mcp.a2a-grocery.ai/mcp · https://mcp.a2a-cosmetics.ai/mcp · https://mcp.a2a-peptides.ai/mcp · https://mcp.a2a-retailmedia.ai/mcp
- Agent-to-Agent (A2A): https://a2a-grocery.ai/a2a and the other hubs at /a2a
- Sign-in: OAuth 2.1 client credentials at https://a2a-registry.ai/oauth/register — reads are open, writes need a Bearer
- Payment: x402, USDC on Base, after the gate

## Gate
Call resolve_jurisdiction, then resolve_actor, then gate_transaction before any availability, price, documents, order or hand-off tool. Those tools refuse without an allow decision.

## Scale
353,510 makers · 8,619 retail banners · 1,973,447 points of sale · 20 markets across North America, the UK, the EU and Asia · AI agent traffic · 50M · 30-day trailing · record 26.5 a second, October 7, 2026.

## Operator
GreenCore Solutions Corp. (GSC) · Vancouver, Canada · London, UK · Microsoft AI Cloud Partner · https://gsc-em.com · https://gsc-investor.ai

Notice: Artificial intelligence makes mistakes. GSC hubs are agentic information sources, not recommendations. No ads, ever. No rank for sale. Trade only.
